Bangkok to Chiang Mai

Fly in about 70 minutes or take SRT trains 9 and 10 overnight from Krung Thep Aphiwat.

FlightAbout 70 minutes, BKK or DMK to CNX
TrainSRT 9/10 sleeper, about 12 hours
Who should trainAnyone who wants the ride, not a 6:00 meeting

The return is the same mix. Train 10 is the useful southbound sleeper. Confirm today's numbers on SRT the week you ride.

Ways to go

ModeTimeNotes
FlightAbout 70 minutesPlus airport time at both ends. Book BKK-CNX or DMK-CNX.
SRT 9 / 10About 12 hoursDeparts Krung Thep Aphiwat. Book a sleeper berth.
Day trainAbout 12 hoursSeats, not berths. Fine if you like rice fields more than sleep.
Bus9-11 hoursWorks. The sleeper train is the better overnight.

Common questions

Which Bangkok station?
Krung Thep Aphiwat for trains 9 and 10. Do not go to Hua Lamphong for this sleeper.
BKK or DMK to CNX?
Both fly it. Match the airport you already use. A cross-town airport change can erase the flight's advantage.
